name: season
title: Seasonal cash review
subtitle: Actuals to the cutoff, forecasts after it. Recorded cash only; review coverage before relying on a balance.

sections.title: Monthly cash
sections.sql: select farm,currency,month,basis,net_cents,closing_cents,headroom_cents,cells,status from v_cashflow order by farm,month

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select farm,kind,record,detail from v_attention order by farm,kind

sections.title: Production
sections.sql: select farm,enterprise,month,unit,budget_qty,actual_qty,variance_qty,variance_pct from v_production order by farm,month

sections.title: Livestock count
sections.sql: select farm,enterprise,month,stock_class,opening,births,purchases,sales,deaths,closing,expected_closing,difference from v_livestock order by farm,month
